name: Scribe
description: Scribe automatically captures how work gets done and turns it into step-by-step documentation, providing "workflow context for teams & AI agents" without manual write-up.
best_for: Teams that need process documentation, SOPs, and training guides created automatically, including enterprises implementing AI agents that need context on how work actually happens.
features: Automatic capture of workflows as step-by-step guides while you work
Desktop apps for Windows and Mac plus Chrome and Edge browser extensions
AI-driven workflow optimization that surfaces inefficiencies and bottlenecks
Workflow AI that gives AI agents context on real business processes
Automatic redaction of sensitive information for SOC 2, HIPAA, CCPA, and GDPR compliance
Performance analytics measuring where automation has the most impact
Ready-made template gallery for common business processes
API and MCP integrations for connecting to other enterprise tools

alternatives.name: Guru
alternatives.description: A knowledge management platform that verifies and surfaces answers directly inside a team's existing tools.
alternatives.best_for: Teams that want verified knowledge capture alongside workflow documentation.

alternatives.name: Helpjuice
alternatives.description: A knowledge base platform for centralizing and searching company documentation.
alternatives.best_for: Support and operations teams that want a searchable central knowledge hub.

pricing.starting_price: Free plan available; Pro is paid per user with monthly or annual billing

cons: On a Pro Team, every team member becomes a paid Pro seat; paid and free seats cannot be mixed within the same Pro Team.
Official support documentation confirms monthly and annual Pro billing but does not expose a stable public numeric Pro price in the documentation reviewed.
